template: Clean character turnaround reference image for a video game 3D model. One costumed superhero character in a full-body costume with a full head mask, standing in a neutral A-pose: arms straight and angled 45 degrees downward away from the sides, palms facing inward, legs straight, feet slightly apart. Front view, facing the camera directly, symmetrical, entire character visible from head to toe with empty margin around it, centered. Flat medium-gray studio background, soft even lighting, no shadows, no text, no props. Detailed costume material texture, sharp focus, 3D game character render. COSTUME:

suits.claude: a matte black high-tech costume with terracotta-orange panel accents on the shoulders, forearms and shins. The main chest emblem is a large Claude AI logo: a terracotta-orange radial starburst spark with many irregular rounded rays. A smooth full helmet with a single wide glowing orange visor band, orange soles, subtle fine knit fabric texture.
suits.codex: a stark monochrome black-and-white high-tech costume: white chest, upper arms and thighs, black sides, black gloves, black shoulders and black boots, crisp black seam lines between panels. The main chest emblem is a large black OpenAI Codex logo: the hexagonal interlocking knot blossom mark. A smooth white full helmet with a glossy black glass faceplate visor, matte rubberised fabric with a subtle raised hexagon texture. No other colours at all.
suits.gemini: a bright red and deep blue classic hero costume: red helmet, chest, gloves and boots, deep blue sides, arms and legs, raised embossed metallic silver trim lines along the panel edges. The main chest emblem is a large Google Gemini logo: a four-pointed sparkle star with a blue to purple to pink gradient. A full helmet with a silver mirrored wraparound visor, glossy padded fabric with a fine raised dimple texture.
suits.kimi: a dark crimson and navy high-tech costume: crimson helmet, chest and forearms, navy blue sides, upper arms, legs and boots, thin black seam lines and armored navy knee and shoulder plates. The main chest emblem is a large Kimi AI logo: a bold white letter K with a small bright blue dot, on a black rounded badge. A full helmet with an amber-gold mirrored visor band, matte technical fabric with a fine carbon-weave texture, dark red soles.
suits.qwen: a bright red and royal blue modern high-tech costume: red helmet, chest, shoulders, gloves and boots, royal blue sides, upper arms and legs, thick black trim lines separating red and blue panels. The main chest emblem is a large Qwen AI logo: a violet-purple hexagonal star made of interlocking angled strokes. A full helmet with a black faceplate and one thin bright white glowing horizontal visor slit, sleek modern technical fabric.
